scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "cross-env ENV=desenvolvimento PORT=8080 DB_PATH=./app/infra/database.db go run ./app/backend/main.go" "cd app/frontend && npm run dev -- --port 3000"
scripts.hml: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "amber.bold,yellow.bold" "cross-env ENV=homologacao PORT=8081 DB_PATH=./hml/infra/database.db go run ./app/backend/main.go" "cd app/frontend && npm run dev:hml -- --port 3001"
scripts.prod: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "emerald.bold,green.bold" "cross-env ENV=producao PORT=8082 DB_PATH=./prod/infra/database.db go run ./app/backend/main.go" "cd app/frontend && npm run build && npm run preview -- --port 3002"
